title: The App Market
drDigitalIntro:
Your computer comes with one place to get new apps. Here it is called App Market.
• Somebody checks every app before it is listed. That makes it far safer than downloading from a website you happened to find.
• You can look through the categories, or type a name into the search box.
• Each app shows stars and reviews from people already using it. Read two or three before you install anything.
• The rule to remember: get apps from here, never from a pop-up that tells you that you need one.

steps.say: Click 'Games' to browse the Games category.
Click Zen Garden to see its details, reviews, and screenshots.
Notice the rating, reviews, and the 'No ads' tag. Now go back to the App Market.

drDigitalSuccess: You browsed the App Market! Ratings, reviews, and tags tell you a lot before you install. Always check them.
drDigitalHint: Click a category to browse, then click an app name to see its full listing.
